title: Automated research engine v1
goal: Design and prove a provenance-preserving automated research engine that turns scholarly literature into structured evidence, durable knowledge, challenged research gaps, fundable research programs, and workspace-control-executable research projects.
acceptance_criteria: The architecture explicitly separates source evidence, extracted evidence, normalized knowledge, synthesis, model inference, and human judgment.
Every durable scientific evidence object can be traced to a canonical work/version, immutable source artifact identity, and source locator whenever the available representation permits it.
Literature discovery and lawful acquisition use provider-independent adapters and record exact discovery/acquisition provenance and access state.
The first vertical slice can discover a broad candidate corpus, triage it, deeply process a bounded high-value subset, and answer benchmark research questions with traceable evidence.
The knowledge layer preserves contradictory findings and experimental context rather than silently reconciling them.
Research-gap candidates are generated from evidence patterns and undergo an adversarial novelty-challenge search before being treated as supported open questions.
At least one surviving gap can be expanded into a structured research program with hypotheses, experiments, risks, assets, evaluation criteria, and falsification conditions.
The funding layer can match a research program to current official opportunities and compile solicitation-specific proposal inputs without autonomous submission.
An approved research program can transition into a durable workspace-control project/task workflow without reconstructing the research plan from conversation state.
A pilot in a narrow domain demonstrates that scaling the corpus increases durable, provenance-backed knowledge rather than merely increasing generated summary text.
The authoritative task JSON and maintained Markdown cold-start handoff remain synchronized after every material task-state mutation.
constraints: Do not treat model-generated prose as primary scientific evidence.
Do not claim research novelty solely from model judgment; challenge candidate novelty with targeted literature searches designed to find prior work.
Do not bypass paywalls, authentication controls, publisher restrictions, or licensing terms.
Keep provider-specific APIs behind adapters; no single scholarly index, parser, model, vector store, or RAG service is the architecture.
Do not silently reconcile contradictory papers; preserve source context and disagreement.
Do not choose storage technology before defining the evidence/provenance contract it must support.

Do not embed the full research-engine implementation into workspace-control before the implementation repository boundary is explicitly decided; workspace-control currently owns the architecture/task state and control semantics.
Use staged corpus triage so deep-reading cost scales with relevance rather than raw discovery volume.
Require explicit human approval for consequential research-direction selection, proposal submission, and other configured scientific decision gates.
Use direct tools first where evidence can be established remotely; introduce local runtime only when parsing, computation, scale tests, or environment-bound validation require it.
Treat the generated Markdown task handoff as the standard pasteable cold-start surface and keep it synchronized with the JSON capsule.

evidence: Architecture document defines the literature-to-evidence-to-gap-to-proposal-to-execution loop, trust boundaries, acquisition strategy, evidence graph, novelty challenge, proposal layer, and first vertical slice.

Defined canonical Work, WorkVersion, SourceArtifact, SourceLocator, DiscoveryRun, CorpusDecision, typed scientific evidence, Inference, EvidenceRelation, VerificationEvent, and SynthesisArtifact records.
Defined explicit evidence-to-source traceability, numerical integrity, missing-evidence semantics, contradiction handling, correction/retraction propagation, and novelty-challenge representation.
No database, vector store, parser, or LLM implementation was selected as part of the contract.

Current official APIs support large-scale bibliographic discovery and lawful-access resolution through multiple independent providers.
OpenAlex documentation reports cached full text for more than 50 million OA works and TEI XML for roughly 43 million.
Crossref exposes DOI/funder/license metadata and deposited full-text/TDM links where available.
Unpaywall supports DOI-level OA resolution; Semantic Scholar exposes graph/recommendation/dataset APIs.
Grants.gov exposes programmatic funding-opportunity search/detail retrieval for the downstream proposal layer.

remaining_work: Prototype multi-provider literature discovery with reproducible DiscoveryRun records and canonical work/version identity.
Prototype lawful full-text resolution/acquisition with explicit access-state and artifact hashing.
Build normalized parsing and typed evidence extraction with source locators and verification state.
Choose persistence/indexing architecture only after real ingress/extraction objects demonstrate storage/query requirements.
Build provenance-preserving synthesis, contradiction handling, gap generation, and adversarial novelty challenge.
Build the research-program/funding/proposal layer and explicit human gates.
Bridge an approved research program into a workspace-control project execution workflow.
Run the narrow-domain vertical slice and measure evidence fidelity, traceability, novelty false-positive rate, and execution handoff quality.
next_safe_action: Begin the ingress prototype on automated-research-engine-v1 by defining a reproducible DiscoveryRun/corpus manifest and testing provider adapters on a narrow pilot query in open-set/open-world RF sensing. Use OpenAlex-class discovery first, resolve identifiers/versions, then attempt lawful full-text resolution while recording access state. Do not build the database yet.
notes: The first pilot should use a narrow domain close to current expertise (for example open-set/open-world RF sensing and RF signal classification) so system outputs can be checked against expert understanding. The long-term engine is domain-general.
